Name: Mustard
Author: raideno12
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I’ve created a mustard plant based on the real thing, where the end product is mustard in a jar.
The ripe mustard seeds can then be processed into mustard in the press.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Mustard Seed with the Grow phases and the end product for sell or gift for NPC

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Only Smapi is required[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks for inspire from the other Mod Developer and Eric Baron the Developer of Stardew Valley Game[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4] Problems or other Things:[/size][/b][/color]
If you encounter any problems or bugs, or if you have any inspiring ideas for the development of future products, please post them and I’ll take a look.

Downloads.Description: A quick mini-update: the gift feature has now been added for NPCs, and there have been price adjustments for buying and selling mustard products.
